name: The R Villa Luwa
bedroomsText: 5 (4 with a king-size bed, 1 with a queen-size bed), each with its own bathroom

facts.text: 5 bedrooms: 4 with a king-size bed and 1 with a queen-size bed. Each bedroom has its own bathroom, 5 bathrooms in total.
The master bathroom has a freestanding bathtub.
A garden, a barbecue grill, a patio or balcony and a private entrance.
Free parking on the premises and on the street.
A sound system in all rooms and the garden; air conditioning that can be controlled from a smartphone; WiFi.
Kitchen with stove, oven, microwave, kettle, coffee maker, dishwasher and refrigerator; dining table; a washer.
A crib and a high chair are available.
In Pererenan near Canggu, about 45 to 60 minutes by car from Ngurah Rai Airport.
